english.note: Use this specifically when putting ammunition into a gun rather than restoring electrical power or personal energy.

examples.english: The gun is out of bullets, so I need to recharge it before I can keep firing.
examples.traditional: 部槍冇彈，我要上彈先可以繼續開槍。
